<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

function vgml_demo_png( $w, $h, $r, $g, $b ) {
    $raw = '';
    for ( $y = 0; $y < $h; $y++ ) {
        $raw .= chr( 0 ) . str_repeat( chr( $r ) . chr( $g ) . chr( $b ), $w );
    }
    $chunk = function ( $type, $data ) {
        return pack( 'N', strlen( $data ) ) . $type . $data . pack( 'N', crc32( $type . $data ) );
    };
    $ihdr = pack( 'NN', $w, $h ) . chr( 8 ) . chr( 2 ) . chr( 0 ) . chr( 0 ) . chr( 0 );
    return "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" . $chunk( 'IHDR', $ihdr ) . $chunk( 'IDAT', gzcompress( $raw, 6 ) ) . $chunk( 'IEND', '' );
}

foreach ( array( 'Logos', 'Photos', 'Icons', 'Screenshots' ) as $name ) {
    if ( ! term_exists( $name, 'media_category' ) ) {
        wp_insert_term( $name, 'media_category' );
    }
}

if ( ! get_user_by( 'login', 'editor' ) ) {
    wp_insert_user( array(
        'user_login'   => 'editor',
        'user_pass'    => wp_generate_password(),
        'role'         => 'editor',
        'display_name' => 'Second Author',
    ) );
}

$terms = get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => 'media_category', 'hide_empty' => false ) );
$dir   = wp_upload_dir();

$samples = array(
    array( 'Wordmark, dark',      'Logos',       31, 56, 100 ),
    array( 'Wordmark, reversed',  'Logos',       44, 82, 140 ),
    array( 'Harbour at dusk',     'Photos',     176, 104,  62 ),
    array( 'Ridgeline study',     'Photos',      92, 118,  92 ),
    array( 'Cart icon',           'Icons',       58, 110, 130 ),
    array( 'Search icon',         'Icons',       74, 134, 156 ),
    array( 'Grid view, wide',     'Screenshots', 96,  92, 128 ),
    array( 'Grid view, narrow',   'Screenshots', 118, 112, 150 ),
);

$by_name = array();
foreach ( (array) $terms as $t ) {
    $by_name[ $t->name ] = (int) $t->term_id;
}

$i = 0;
foreach ( $samples as $s ) {

    list( $title, $term, $r, $g, $b ) = $s;

    $path = trailingslashit( $dir['path'] ) . 'sample-' . ( ++$i ) . '.png';
    file_put_contents( $path, vgml_demo_png( 480, 320, $r, $g, $b ) );

    $id = wp_insert_attachment( array(
        'post_title'     => $title,
        'post_mime_type' => 'image/png',
        'post_status'    => 'inherit',
    ), $path );

    wp_update_attachment_metadata( $id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $id, $path ) );

    if ( isset( $by_name[ $term ] ) ) {
        wp_set_object_terms( $id, array( $by_name[ $term ] ), 'media_category' );
    }
}

// show every filter and search column, so there is something to try
$o = get_option( 'vergeml_lib_options', array() );
$o['filters_to_show'] = array( 'types', 'dates', 'authors', 'taxonomies' );
$o['search_in']       = array( 'titles', 'captions', 'descriptions', 'filenames', 'authors', 'taxonomies' );
update_option( 'vergeml_lib_options', $o );
